name: Enterprise Capability Assessment and Coverage
constraints: Only WM-ACT-034 is profiled; WM-ACT-001 is reference-only for agent competence and capacity on CapabilityRealization.
WM-ACT-001 enterprise-capability writes freeze at the migration-boundary effective date and unmapped legacy records remain unknown.
Capability Assessment pins subject, criteria, method, scale and scale version, aggregation, decision rule, assessor competence and impartiality before results.
Determiner and decision authority remain separate unless an explicit impartiality exception is governed.
Finalized assessments are immutable and change only by amendment or supersession.
Assessment cannot create, rename, redefine or retire a capability.
Capability Level is a versioned scale definition or an assertion, never an independent root.
Required level is a CapabilityRequirement; actual level is a time-bounded finalized assessment conclusion.
Realization state, maturity, performance, capacity and assessment state are orthogonal dimensions.
Coverage states include unknown and unrealized separately; realized-but-low-maturity is represented as an orthogonal pair.
Coverage and fullness are derived as-of projections over actual realizations and scoped completeness assertions.
Scenario realizations never feed authoritative actual coverage.
Ending the last realization does not retire the capability.
Every adjudicated rule has an accepted, rejected or deferred disposition in audit-remediation.md.
